name: Piper PA-18 Super Cub
variants: Modern clones (e.g. Top Cub, Super Cub kits)
summary: Two-seat tandem tube-and-fabric taildragger, the archetypal bush plane for short, rough strips, floats and banner towing.

wings: High wing braced by V-struts from the lower fuselage
Constant-chord rectangular wing with rounded tips and flaps
engines: Single flat-four in a fully enclosed cowling
fuselage: Tailwheel gear with V-strut main legs, often on oversized tundra tires
Split door on the right: upper half hinges up, lower half drops down

tellTales: V-strut high wing on a narrow tandem-seat fabric fuselage
Tailwheel, often on huge bush tires
Fully enclosed cowling with no exposed cylinders

confusedWith.howToTell: The Super Cub has a fully enclosed cowl, wing flaps and usually bigger tires; the J-3 typically shows exposed cylinder heads and has no flaps.
The Citabria has spring-steel main gear legs and a squared-off fin and rudder; the Super Cub has a strut-braced gear vee and a rounded tail.
The Champ has a deeper, rounder forward fuselage with much more window area; the Super Cub is slimmer and boxier.
